comment: 48yo female from rural region, HPV-positive on most recent screening, gravida 6 para 6 (all full-term vaginal deliveries). High parity (≥5 full-term) synergizes with HPV to increase cervical cancer risk 2-4x vs nulliparous HPV-positive women. Fires RF-REPRODUCTIVE-HIGH-PARITY-CERVICAL-PREVENTION. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-REPRODUCTIVE-HIGH-PARITY-CERVICAL-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (adherence to USPSTF/WHO cervical screening cadence + catch-up HPV vaccination through age 45 per ACIP); alternative = IND-REPRODUCTIVE-HIGH-PARITY-CERVICAL-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (general-population schedule only).
